text:
A horizontal metal plate of area 0.50m2 lies at the bottom of a lake at a depth of 40m.
The density of water is 1000kg/m3 and the gravitational field strength g is 10N/kg.
What is the downward force acting on the plate due to the water?
A
20kN
B
80kN
C
200kN
D
800kN
subject: Physics
